Choose a starting point

Click a topic for a simple example we can work through.

Learn the basics

Start with what an AI assistant can do, where it makes mistakes, and how to check its answers. No technical background needed.

“Explain how AI assistants work in plain English. Give me one useful example and one thing I should double-check.”
Write better prompts

A useful prompt gives the task, the context, and the format you want. We can practice turning a vague question into a clear request.

“Help me write a friendly email inviting a neighbor to dinner on Saturday. Keep it under 60 words and leave the time as a placeholder.”
Use AI for everyday tasks

Try planning a week, organizing notes, or drafting an email. Keep sensitive personal information out of practice examples.

“Help me plan three simple vegetarian dinners for two people. Each should take under 30 minutes. Include one combined grocery list.”
